newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar sticks to narrow range at Tokyo noon.
newsitem.headline: Dollar sticks to narrow range at Tokyo noon.

text.p: 0301 GMT --*Dollar stuck in narrow range at midday Tokyo, with activity subdued amid lack of fresh market-moving factors. *Market focus on European issues, such as uncertainty over EMU and political row in Germany, but operators find it hard to predict future direction of European currencies in Tokyo. *Mark's weakness against yen and dollar continues.
